name: Bordeaux Hills
description: Bordeaux Hills specializes in handcrafted signature cocktails, refreshing mocktails, and premium hookah services. We provide professional mobile bartending and hookah setups for weddings, birthdays, corporate functions, private parties, and special events. Our mission is to elevate every occasion with exceptional service, creative mixology, and a luxurious, unforgettable experience.

name: Borgoe Bar
description: Borgoe Bar is Suriname’s one and only authentic Borgoe Rum tropical bar, located along the Wakapasi near the Palmentuin. Enjoy the full range of SAB’s locally produced rums, vodkas, cocktails, and other delicious drinks in a relaxed outdoor setting. Open from 8 PM, it’s the perfect place to mingle, meet and greet, and enjoy the tropical Surinamese nightlife.

name: Elevate 'our Health
description: Elevate 'our Health is a proudly Surinamese wellness and health education service focused on pain relief, relaxation, physical well-being and healthy living. Our approach is personalized — health is not one-size-fits-all. We consider each person’s needs, lifestyle and well-being to create a more meaningful and tailored experience. As a professional massage therapist and Health Educator, we offer Relaxation, Deep Tissue, Sports, Bamboo and Waran Massage, as well as selected partial massages. Services are available by appointment, including mobile and home-based treatments. We also bring wellness to business events, family days, group activities and retreats, offering massage and health-focused experiences designed to help people relax, reconnect and recharge. At Elevate 'our Health, we believe health should be personal, practical and accessible — wherever people come together. HEALTH. BALANCE. ELEVATED.

name: Giggles and Wiggles
description: We specialize in luxury soft play rentals for babies and toddlers aged 6 months to 5 years, transforming ordinary celebrations into beautiful, playful experiences. From first birthdays and baby showers to family gatherings and special events, our soft play setups give little ones a safe, exciting space to crawl, explore, climb, and play while creating magical memories . Our setups combine modern aesthetics with age-appropriate play equipment, featuring colorful ball pits, soft climbing blocks, playful accessories, and charming details that make every celebration extra special. Whether you’re planning an elegant, timeless setup or a fun, colorful play area, we work with your vision to create a setup that complements your event beautifully.

name: Jobpower Group N.V
description: Jobpower Group is an international recruitment and workforce solutions provider specializing in the Oil & Gas, Energy, and Industrial sectors. We connect businesses with qualified local and international professionals across a wide range of disciplines, delivering reliable staffing solutions in the Netherlands, Suriname, Guyana, and beyond.

name: Sana Budaya
description: Sana Budaya is a cultural and community centre of the Vereniging Herdenking Javaanse Immigratie (VHJI) in Suriname. The centre is dedicated to the preservation, promotion and transmission of Javanese and Surinamese cultural heritage. Sana Budaya provides a range of cultural, educational and community activities, including cultural events, performances, exhibitions, workshops, meetings and other public activities. The centre also provides facilities for cultural fairs, markets, sports and community gatherings. Located on the Sana Budaya premises are the Soeki Irodikromo Volksacademie voor Kunst en Cultuur (VAKC), which supports arts and cultural education, and V.H.J.I. Documentation Centre, which contributes to the preservation, documentation and accessibility of historical and cultural knowledge and materials related to Javanese heritage in Suriname.
